name: delta-miss-held-rr-v5
description: Like delta-hit-rr-v5, with two replicas and no affinity: the fourth connection lands on the old replica (holding fewer entries than B). The SDK returns 409 + cairn-replay: miss + cairn-replay-held: k:h_k (the part it still holds, k = min(held, N)); the runtime checks h_k against the current journal and resends once from k.
